_about: Purchased parts already characterised for the mm-launcher project. Dimensions in mm, with source and status. status: confirmed (user or datasheet or measured from the supplied model), measured (by an agent from a reference file), estimated (from a photo or envelope). Placeholders: components/placeholders.py. Reference files live in ~/code-stuff/mmlauncher/mm-launcher/mm-launch-hw/reference/ (REF below) and are not copied here. connectors: named frames for cadlib.mates (mates.from_component) in the placeholder's local frame: origin on the mating face, z out of the part, optional x, a pattern in minimal form (["rect", px, py], ["circle", pcd, n, a0_deg], ["line", pitch, n], ["points", [[x, y], ...]]) seen from outside the face, and the hole size.
